question: Should `tool-progress` be approved as a distinct public plugin-SDK reply classification alongside the broader `isStatusNotice` contract?
rationale: Both shapes are technically viable, but the choice establishes durable semantics for external plugins and sibling channels; source inspection and green CI cannot determine the intended public API boundary.

options.title: Approve distinct tool progress
options.body: Keep the generic progress kind, define and test how it differs from status notices, and require exact-head lifecycle proof before merge.

options.title: Consolidate into status notices
options.body: Remove the new public symbols and represent transient tool chrome with `isStatusNotice` while keeping reaction selection and suppression Slack-owned.

recommendation.title: Approve distinct tool progress
recommendation.body: Keep the generic progress kind, define and test how it differs from status notices, and require exact-head lifecycle proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the overlapping current-main status-notice contract and has the strongest available history signal for deciding its intended scope.
